parsed.why: Comprehensive gender-identity anti-discrimination law, depathologised recognition, official condemnation of Pride violence; but vague, rarely-enforced protections, under-recorded NGO-reported violence, event-clustered hostility. Resident-facing LGR is no traveller protection; no border or facilities exposure documented.

No criminalisation, gender-identity hate-crime aggravators twice applied, anti-discrimination law in force, free legal aid; but hate speech unpunished, 2019 Pride beating, municipal hostility, severe yet dated 2002 attitude survey. No trans-specific violence rate.

No criminal statute and the 2024 court review ended the old provisions, but no anti-discrimination protection outside the HIV law, 69% wanted criminalisation (2017), police broke up Pride and closed venues, religiously driven hostility with no recourse.

Same-sex conduct criminalised and enforced: 2023 arrests, one-to-two-year sentences, a death in detention; president urged stoning; extrajudicial killings, torture, no rule of law or protection; advocacy works from exile.

Federal document and visa screening refuses or flags marker discrepancies, a few states criminalise facility use, custody abuse documented; but courts block orders, hate-crime and employment protections exist, and most states have no facility ban.
